propositions: Ticking AC checkboxes does not invalidate plan-review attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint basis by _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing.

Attestation staleness messages incorrectly name 'description/AC/file_impact/children' as basis components, but 'AC' is not a component; it lives inside 'description', and the actual basis has exactly four keys plus file_impact_scope when scope is 'none'.

Per-component fingerprints must be added to the signed manifest as deterministic 'material-part:' lines so that stale-material reasons can name which component actually changed, and pre-330c legacy attestations can degrade gracefully without replaying the event store.

All attestation refusal surfaces (stale-material, stale-reopened, unsigned claim gate, dependency changes, child-closure reasons, and signing failures) must be updated to name specific changed components or provide actionable remedies rather than fixed lists or generic advice.

Pre-330c raw-description attestations over unchanged tickets must still report 'certified' via the grandfather logic, and un-grandfatherable ones must report a 'cannot name component' reason rather than spuriously naming one.
